title: Add option for wallpaper to span multiple screens
line: The Image wallpaper has a new "Span across all screens" option that stretches one image over all monitors, each showing its own part.
explanation: Each screen's wallpaper item always laid the image out over that screen alone, so a wide image meant for several monitors was shown whole (and cropped) on every screen. There was no way to have one picture continue across monitors. The Image wallpaper gets a SpanScreens setting and a "Span across all screens" checkbox under Positioning (shown only with more than one screen). When it is on, each screen lays the image out over the bounding box of all screens (Qt.application.screens) offset by its own position and clips to itself, so the chosen positioning mode applies to the whole desktop and the slices join at the screen edges, updating live when screens are moved, added or removed.

commits.message:
wallpapers/image: add option to span the image across all screens

Every screen always showed the whole wallpaper image, so a wide picture
made for several monitors was repeated on each of them. Add a "Span
across all screens" option that lays the image over the whole desktop.

BUG: 393781

media.caption: Pure master, two 1280x800 screens side by side, same 2560x800 image on both: each screen shows the whole image cropped, the circle and the line repeat
With "Span across all screens" on: one image over both screens, LEFT/RIGHT at the far edges, circle and line continue across the seam
Desktop and Wallpaper settings on master: no span option
New "Span across all screens" checkbox under Positioning (Image wallpaper, more than one screen)
The lock screen uses the same wallpaper code and spans too when the option is set for it
